scientific_goal: One SCI paper: task-conditioned executable parameter adaptation ACROSS REAL MULTI-STAGE ROBOT SKILLS using nominal skill primitives and measured SkillResult to improve successor feasibility, whole-task success and transfer; contact servo and SAC are component baselines
next_action: EXP-003 is a two-track SCI research task: (A) add an identical observable dwell/hold completion contract to all controllers, compare trained lateral-Y-only vs full-YZ/advance SAC+critic-LN on NEW Y-only and genuinely YZ/task-variation scenes, plus search; count complete physics and skill decisions, preserve the same legal actions/inputs. (B, high paper priority) immediately scout actual two-decision skill chains PickTool→UseTool or PlaceA/Release→PickC/PlaceC under strong non-weakened planning; demonstrate legal predecessor parameters affect successor feasibility and subsequent redecision; actively discover a learned mechanism with controlled comparison to STAP/Foresight and ordinary same-interface RL. Only if observation-aliasing is established, consider POMDP belief/active probing. Produce original+highlight synchronized complete videos of BOTH skill transitions and physical effect graphs, not only local insert clips. Run actual code and multiple grounded experiments before finishing; no claim of novelty without repeated evidence.

experiments.primary_claim: Distinguish control defects and nondeterminism from state-dependent contact failures.
Find physically useful, executable contact-phase corrections under full-task constraints.
Get well-trained same-authority residual RL, with full-cost baselines.
Isolate additional causal value of explicit action-effect feedback over equal-observation/history RL and strong planning.
After a reliable independent gain, test novel conditions, another contact mechanism and industrial adapter.

unresolved_questions: Can one executable multi-stage task have two meaningful parameter decision boundaries that affect downstream success beyond strong fixed/search baselines and native geometry?
Does including successor contract and actual predecessor SkillResult change an RL parameter decision and improve whole-task outcome with identical action authority?
Under a shared observable completion contract and real new YZ settings, can strong LN residual SAC learn robustly without Z-channel degeneration or transient-success loss?
Which closest prior model (STAP/Foresight/SCOUT/DAWN) explains any improvement, and what mechanism remains distinct after ablation?
Are latent tool/grasp/contact dynamics actually partially observable and identifiable from action-effect history? If not avoid unnecessary POMDP.
